suffix: Iconic emblem for a YouTube channel avatar about the psychology of money, bold flat 1950s print-advertisement style with subtle halftone, centered in a circle, strong silhouette that reads at tiny size, palette of cream, money green, tomato red, mustard gold and ink black, no text, no lettering, no currency symbols, no eyes
quality: Masterful graphic design, confident simple shapes, generous negative space, print texture.
caption: Логотипы на основе 59, 60, 63 (69–78)

items.69-head-piggy: a human head in side profile whose back of the head becomes a piggy bank with a coin slot, one jigsaw piece missing at the forehead
items.70-candle-head: a clean human head profile built from a few bold stock-market candlestick bars in green and red, simple and geometric
items.71-bubble-puzzle: a price tag shaped like a thought bubble with a string, inside it a human head profile with one jigsaw puzzle piece missing
items.72-puzzle-lift: a human head profile silhouette with one jigsaw piece lifting out of the top of the head, a small red price tag inside the gap
items.73-guilloche-head: a human head profile silhouette filled with fine banknote guilloche engraving patterns in money green
items.74-gears-chart: a human head profile whose forehead and nose line is a zig-zag market chart, small gold gears turning inside the head
items.75-piggy-cutout: a piggy bank with a human head profile cut out of its side as negative space, bold paper-cutout style
items.76-piggy-thinks: a piggy bank with a thought bubble above it containing a small candlestick chart
